threads.body: This comment now states the server is started \"as a child\", but the PR description notes cases where the real server can be a grandchild (or otherwise indirectly spawned). Since the reason for a separate process group is to reliably terminate the whole descendant tree, consider rewording to something like \"spawns the real server process (directly or indirectly) and waits for it\" to avoid encoding an overly specific (and potentially incorrect) parent/child relationship.
